sub_graphs.title: EIP-2976: Typed Transaction Gossip Protocol

nodes.label: Typed Transaction Created
nodes.description: A typed transaction (TransactionType || TransactionPayload) has been created locally

nodes.label: Encode Typed Transaction
nodes.description: Encode transaction as TransactionType (1 byte, 0-0x7f) concatenated with TransactionPayload

nodes.label: Broadcast via Transactions (0x02)
nodes.description: Send typed transactions to peers using Transactions message

nodes.label: Transaction Propagated to Peers
nodes.description: Typed transaction has been sent to connected peers

nodes.description: Remote peer has received the typed transaction

nodes.label: Decode Transaction Type

sub_graphs.title: EIP-2976: Transaction Type Validation
sub_graphs.description: Models the validation rules for typed transactions including unknown type handling

nodes.label: Transaction Message Received
nodes.description: A Transactions, PooledTransactions, or block message with transactions received

nodes.label: Extract Transaction Type
nodes.description: Read the first byte as TransactionType (unsigned 8-bit, range 0-0x7f)

nodes.label: Check If Type Known
nodes.description: Determine if this TransactionType is recognized by the client

nodes.label: Transaction Type Known
nodes.description: Client recognizes this transaction type and can parse the payload

nodes.label: Transaction Type Unknown
nodes.description: Client does not recognize this transaction type

nodes.label: Parse Transaction Payload
nodes.description: Decode TransactionPayload according to known type schema

nodes.label: Validate Transaction Payload
nodes.description: Verify payload is valid according to type-specific rules

nodes.label: Transaction Valid
nodes.description: Transaction type known and payload is valid

nodes.label: Transaction Invalid
nodes.description: Transaction payload failed validation

nodes.label: Disconnect Peer
nodes.description: SHOULD disconnect the peer that sent unknown type or invalid payload

external_entities.name: Remote Peer Node
external_entities.description: Peer sending transactions via devp2p protocol

sub_graphs.title: EIP-2976: Transaction Type Activation Rules
sub_graphs.description: Models the rules for when new transaction types can be sent based on fork activation

nodes.label: Before Fork Activation Block
nodes.description: Network is before the fork block that introduces a new TransactionType

nodes.label: Fork Activation Block Reached
nodes.description: The introductory fork block for a new TransactionType has been reached

nodes.label: Check Fork Activation Block
nodes.description: Determine if current block height >= fork activation block for tx type

nodes.label: New Type Can Be Sent
nodes.description: Client MAY now send the new TransactionType to peers

nodes.label: New Type Cannot Be Sent Yet
nodes.description: MUST NOT send new TransactionType until fork block

nodes.label: Receive Pre-Fork Transaction
nodes.description: Node receives a new TransactionType well before activation

nodes.label: May Disconnect Early Sender
nodes.description: Node MAY disconnect peer sending new type too early

sub_graphs.title: EIP-2976: Typed Transactions in Block Messages
sub_graphs.description: Models how typed transactions are included in NewBlock and BlockBodies messages

nodes.label: Block Contains Typed Transactions
nodes.description: A block has been produced containing one or more typed transactions

nodes.label: Build NewBlock Message
nodes.description: Construct NewBlock (0x07) message with TransactionList containing typed transactions

nodes.label: Broadcast NewBlock
nodes.description: Send NewBlock message to peers

nodes.label: Peer Received Block
nodes.description: Remote peer has received the NewBlock message

nodes.label: Extract Transaction List
nodes.description: Extract TransactionList from block body

nodes.label: Validate All Transaction Types
nodes.description: Validate each transaction type and payload in the block

nodes.label: Block Transactions Valid
nodes.description: All typed transactions in block are valid

ambiguities.text: Clients 'SHOULD' disconnect peers sending unknown transaction types, but MAY choose not to for trusted peers
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume most implementations will disconnect by default, but may have configuration options for trusted peer exceptions.

ambiguities.text: What constitutes 'well before' the activation block for early transaction receipt
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume a reasonable buffer period (e.g., 100 blocks before activation) where early transactions are tolerated, with stricter enforcement further from activation.

ambiguities.text: No specification for handling the case where a block contains mixed known and unknown transaction types
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume the entire block should be rejected if it contains any unknown transaction types, as partial processing could lead to state inconsistencies.

implicit_assumptions.description: Attackers cannot exploit unknown transaction types to crash or freeze nodes before they disconnect
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: DoS attacks possible by sending malformed unknown types that cause parsing errors or resource exhaustion before disconnect

implicit_assumptions.description: All nodes in the network upgrade to support new transaction types before the fork activation block
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Network partitioning possible where upgraded and non-upgraded nodes disagree on block validity

implicit_assumptions.description: Peers correctly implement the disconnection behavior for unknown types
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Bandwidth amplification attacks possible if nodes relay unknown types instead of disconnecting

implicit_assumptions.description: TransactionType values are assigned coordinately through the EIP process to avoid collisions
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Different networks or forks could have conflicting type definitions causing interoperability issues
